description: Full-text search across every SEC EDGAR filing (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, S-1 and more). Returns matching filings with company, form type, filing date and direct SEC link. Official SEC data, no key needed. Pay-per-call $0.001 (USDC on Base, x402/MPP - a 402 challenge is returned on unpaid calls).
